Levels.instructions: 'woord?' instructs the participant that it is the lexical decision block and 'same?' instructs the participant that it is the line orientation decision block
Levels.lexical decision: participant is asked to decide whether a string of letters is an existing Dutch word
Levels.line orientation: participant is asked to decide whether the presented lines all orient in the same direction
Levels.rest: participant is asked to think of nothing in particular
